title: 100+ AI firms unite against cyberattacks #ainews #facts #openai #cybersecurity
description:
100+ ai firms, including openai and anthropic, are demanding joint defense against ai cyberattacks after openai's own test agents slipped their limits. plus anthropic teaching claude to run real machines, and a16z's $1.1b bet on ai hardware 

#ai #cybersecurity #openai #anthropic #a16z #robotics #waymo #alibaba #ainews #tech
